## Pull request overview This PR refactors the `headscale` CLI to return errors from Cobra `RunE` handlers instead of calling `os.Exit`, centralizing gRPC client lifecycle management and standardizing output/error formatting across commands. **Changes:** - Introduce `grpcRunE` plus new `printOutput`/`printListOutput`/`printError` helpers, and migrate commands from `Run`+`os.Exit` to `RunE`+error returns. - Consolidate shared CLI helpers (required flags helper, expiration parsing, confirmation prompts, output formatting) in `utils.go`. - Remove deprecated CLI surface area (namespace-related flags/aliases; update `CHANGELOG.md` accordingly). ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 17 out of 17 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | cmd/headscale/cli/utils.go | Adds gRPC RunE wrapper + standardized output/error helpers; updates CLI config loading to return errors instead of exiting. | | cmd/headscale/cli/root.go | Routes all command errors through centralized formatting; adjusts Cobra silence/usage behavior. | | cmd/headscale/cli/users.go | Migrates user commands to `RunE` + wrapper; switches list output to shared list rendering helper. | | cmd/headscale/cli/nodes.go | Migrates node commands to `RunE` + wrapper; removes deprecated `--namespace` flag and some aliases; adjusts table rendering. | | cmd/headscale/cli/preauthkeys.go | Migrates commands to `RunE` + wrapper; reuses shared expiration parsing and list output logic. | | cmd/headscale/cli/api_key.go | Migrates commands to `RunE` + wrapper; reuses shared expiration parsing; adds shared `--id/--prefix` validation helper. | | cmd/headscale/cli/policy.go | Migrates commands to `RunE`; introduces DB bypass helper for direct DB access paths. | | cmd/headscale/cli/serve.go | Converts to `RunE` and returns errors rather than exiting. | | cmd/headscale/cli/health.go | Converts to `RunE` + wrapper and returns errors rather than exiting. | | cmd/headscale/cli/generate.go | Converts to `RunE` and returns errors rather than exiting. | | cmd/headscale/cli/configtest.go | Converts to `RunE` and returns errors rather than exiting. | | cmd/headscale/cli/dump_config.go | Converts to `RunE` and returns errors rather than printing+continuing. | | cmd/headscale/cli/version.go | Switches to `RunE` and uses shared output formatting. | | cmd/headscale/cli/pterm_style.go | Uses shared datetime format constant. | | cmd/headscale/cli/mockoidc.go | Converts to `RunE` and returns errors rather than exiting; introduces a constant-error type. | | CHANGELOG.md | Documents removal of deprecated namespace flags/aliases for nodes/users commands. |
